subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the given blanks, will complete the letter series.

_T Z S S T _ Y S S T T _ S S_T W _ S
solution:
Given: _T Z S S T _ Y S S T T _S S _ T W _ S

We consider each option:

1) T X T T S - __**T**__ T Z S S - T __**X**__ Y S S - T T __T__ S S - __T__ T W __**S**__ S

2) X T X T T - __X __T Z S S - T __T__ Y S S - T T __X__ S S - __T__ T W __T__ S

3) **T T X T S - **__T____ __T Z S S - T __T__ Y S S - T T __X__ S S - __T__ T W __S__ S

__
 
• Z is shifting one preceding letter. 

4) T S X T S - T __T Z S S - T __S__ Y S S - T T __X__ S S - __T__ T W __S__ S

The pattern 'T T _ S S' is followed in option 3)

Hence **the correct answer '**T T X T S'.
